independence.statement: Independent non-DPA pre-outcome audit of exact freeze commit 4d8688d82b80e75771c52e3d235ac2c5cc493951. The reviewer rehashed the complete tracked R3 packet and allowlisted sources and replayed only the non-focal witness harness. No focal evaluator was created, executed or inspected, and no focal or invalid R1/R2 outcome was accessed. Source typing and the corrected unit-counting prospective algebra pass, but executable endpoint discrimination, unsigned-swap specificity, bounded-inner exclusion, closability, E2 retention and access-control enforcement fail or remain unresolved.
